_comment: Declared exceptions to the public-API shape rules enforced by
mirror   one entry point exporting both `X` and `<Prefix>X` of the same kind.
homonym  one name exported from two entry points resolving to different declarations.
Every entry needs a reason. An allowance that stops matching anything fails the
check, so stale exemptions cannot accumulate silently. Prefer fixing the surface
over adding an entry here: each one is a place a reader must be told which of two
